phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, early game, both sides have heavy economy and expansion, defense light or uncertain, your army minimal (Queen only), opponent shows Zergling and Queen.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of early aggression, or if you need to adjust your tech path based on scouting.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, keep production and expansion steady, and maintain a defensive buffer against potential early pressure.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology while preparing to defend; maintain production and expansion, but be ready to build defensive units if pressure comes.
phase_policies.title: Early Economy and Tech Focus with Defense Preparation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to economy and tech while neglecting defense; ensure you have sufficient defensive capability to respond to early Zergling pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 300 seconds, early-midgame, both players in ground-oriented macro posture, heavy economy and expansion, moderate production/tech, enemy shows Zergling and Queen cues with possible pressure.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if enemy pressure increases, if you spot a tech switch (e.g., air), or if your economy/tech advantage becomes clear.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance economy, tech, and ground army; keep production and expansion steady while staying alert to pressure.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and tech while strengthening ground army; maintain current production and expansion pace, but keep safety checks in mind.
phase_policies.title: Balanced Ground Macro Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect army production entirely, leaving yourself vulnerable to a sudden attack; maintain a ground army to deter aggression.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 420-540 seconds, midgame, both sides have moderate to heavy defense, heavy economy, moderate to heavy production/tech, your army includes Roach cues alongside Zergling and Queen, opponent shows Roach and Queen cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of air tech, heavy pressure, or if you need to transition to a more defensive or aggressive stance.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on ground army durability with Roaches, sustain economy and tech, and keep defense robust to handle pressure.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army by adding Roaches for durability; maintain economy and tech development, and keep defense at a moderate to increased level.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Strengthening with Stability
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-invest in technology without sufficient army, and do not neglect scouting for tech switches; maintain a strong ground presence.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600-720 seconds, late-midgame, both sides have heavy economy, defense, production, and tech, your army is ground-based with Zergling and Queen, opponent shows Zergling, Roach, Queen.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows air tech, or if you need to transition to a more defensive or aggressive stance.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Scale economy and tech with upgrades, keep ground army strong, and stay flexible to adapt to tech switches.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy and tech further, consider upgrades; maintain ground army and production, but be ready to adapt if the opponent tech switches.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Heavy Macro and Tech Scaling
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-invest in technology without sufficient army, and do not neglect scouting for tech switches; maintain a strong ground presence.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
